title: Kusanagi Nene — Understanding Tokiwa Gozen〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Where'd I put my lunch...? O-Oww...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I'm sore all over because of Mr. Kijima's workouts...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My stamina still has a lot left to be desired compared to how much Emu and Tsukasa have...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Isn't there a quick and efficient way for me to increase it...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm starved. Are you having lunch with Toya again, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, he's got library committee stuff today. I was just gonna have lunch in our classroom.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Wait, those two...!
They might know a good way...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry, Shiraishi, Shinonome...
There's something I wanna ask you guys.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, this troupe you're talking about sounds awesome! Mikazukigumi, right? And you guys get to train with them...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you want to increase your stamina to make the most of what you do with them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that's the thing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I run and do a little strength training...
But I was wondering if you guys could tell me about any other exercises or anything that you think could be good.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, Shiraishi, how do you train normally?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I run, but only on days when I feel like it... I also do some strength training... And I sing. That's about it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sing...?
Yeah, that makes sense considering what your team does.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's the thing. We're not really in the same field, so I'm not sure how much what we say is going to help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But the last time I practiced on my own...
Given that it was a holiday, I would've spent about half of it singing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That much...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. My logic is that if you wanna become a singer with a lot of stamina, you gotta sing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Again, I run and do some strength training, but I don't really follow a strict regimen... I decide that day what I feel like doing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks...
That style really suits you, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, singing can be pretty physically intensive.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right, since it can be an aerobic exercise that involves diaphragmatic breathing... I might try singing for half a day like you just said...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, Shinonome, I'd like to ask you the same question.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well, I mostly do what An does.
I run, do strength workouts and sing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I have been making sure to run every morning and stretch before I go to bed each night to make them a part of my daily routine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Your daily routine, huh?
I didn't realize you were so diligent about this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? Akito's such a stickler for fine details sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, unlike this other whimsical person I know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whimsical?! What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We couldn't help but overhear you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nene, An & Akito
rows.Line:
What?
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: You want a quick and efficient way to increase your stamina, right? We can help you with that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, were you guys eavesdropping?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry!
We sorta overheard partway through...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Anyway, in our club, we jump rope a lot! It's a great way to strengthen your core!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, is it that good a core workout...?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: It is! We usually spend around twenty minutes doing that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
That means I can work out anywhere as long as I carry one around with me.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Oh, me next! I saw on TV the other day that jump squats are supposed to be really good!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, jumping and squatting...?
That sounds really hard, but I'll try looking it up later...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Also, it's super important to know when to take your protein!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Protein? I dunno...
I've heard that some don't really taste all that great...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Actually, they have a lot of good ones now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, like the one I had the other day.
That cheesy gratin flavor protein bar!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Cheesy gratin...?
That's a real product?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?
I decided to have it after an event since I got a little hungry, but it ended up being really good.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Really?!
I was also wondering what it actually tasted like. I might go give it a try now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great! I hope things go well with increasing your stamina and training with Mikazukigumi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Based on what you just told us, it sounds like they do some pretty hard workouts. But you still gotta try your best...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, I will...
